faqs.q: Sec. 102-208. - Computation of sewer user charge.
faqs.a:
The sewer user charge to each user of the sewer system will be computed by applying
               the rate set forth in
section 102-110
to the average bimonthly amount of water used during any period as specified in
section 102-207
. It is the intent of this provision that the usage of water within two complete cycle
               billings, occurring between November 1 and April 30, is used for the purpose of accomplishing
               the computation with the exception for swimming pools and supporting facilities as
               set forth in subsection (a) of this section.
(Code 1981, § 33-112; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 2823, § 14, 7-1-1991)
